title: Simplify Account and Administrator
summary: Account and administrator tools now reveal complexity only when it is needed, with calmer first-level choices and clearer grouping.
changes: Account now opens as four clear destinations: Profile, Preferences, Security, and App & Help, with detailed controls collapsed until requested.
Administrator navigation is reduced to Tonight, People, Roster, and System so occasional administrators no longer face five equally weighted management areas.
Permanent team tools now sit beneath Roster management, while system health, recent administrator activity, exports, and backups live together under System.
The Tonight administrator screen keeps operational status visible and adds direct shortcuts to People & Access, Roster Management, and System.
All existing authentication, permissions, roster calculations, audit, backup, Chat, Supabase and explicit PWA update contracts remain unchanged.
